newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,416 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,416 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,416 contracts compared with 1,501 overnight Sunday.
There were 44 wheat, 567 corn, 630 soybean, 48 soymeal, 106 soyoil, 14 oat, three corn calls, three soybean calls and one soybean put traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/2 cent higher to 3-1/2 cents lower, corn was 1-1/4 to three cents lower and soybeans were 1/2 cent lower to 1-1/2 cents higher.
